examples.name: Default
examples.summary: A ConsoleMockup console screen in the framed panel with three tabs; the scene slot receives the selected tab and shows that widget. The bottom fifth is cropped and faded from the medium breakpoint up.

examples.name: Diagram
examples.summary: `variant="diagram"` lets the scene keep its own height, centered on the plain canvas with no texture, with an action under the title instead of tabs.
